location.section: verse quoted in Candrakīrti's Prasannapadā (local e-text)

paraphrase: What is born from conditions is unborn; it has no arising by own-nature; what depends on conditions is called empty; whoever knows emptiness is heedful.

original.text: yaḥ pratyayairjāyati sa hyajāto no tasya utpādu sabhāvato 'sti
